summary: Risk-off pre-holiday open: AI/chip unwind plus near-certain December Fed hike pricing has QQQ -3.3% and SPY about -2% pre-market (IBKR realtime), with DELL reversing its after-hours pop to -8% and DE -3% on its Q4 miss. Bias leans puts, but most gaps already exceed the implied move and IV is near 52-week highs, so fade risk is high and no pick is rated 55+ until the open confirms; new home sales at 10:00 ET.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: AI unwind and Fed-hike repricing; heavy pre-market volume (~2.4x usual) but the -5.8% gap is 1.4x the implied move and IV is at the 97th percentile, so only a break of the 145.15 pre-market low confirms toward the 140 put wall.

picks.name: Dollar Tree
picks.reason: Defensive rotation after Tuesday's beat-and-raise breakout: flat pre-market while QQQ is -3%, options cheap (IV 68th pct); pre-market volume is thin, so it needs a push through the 157 52-week high.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Chip sell-off has it -7% and under the 396 13-week low; gap is 1.28x the implied move (inside the stretch limit) but IV is at its 13-week high, so it needs to lose the 382 pre-market low.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq futures -3% on AI unwind and hike bets, pre-market volume about 3x usual; but the -3.3% gap is 1.7x the implied move into a pre-holiday session, so the continuation trigger is the 616.5 pre-market low and a reclaim of 621 means a fade.

picks.name: Micron Technology
picks.reason: Weakest of the chips at -8.8% and below the 13-week low on ~3x pre-market volume, but the gap is 1.6x the implied move and pre-open weekly put spreads are wide (15%+), so kept under 55.

picks.name: Workday
picks.reason: Soft Q4 subscription guide has it under the 172.63 13-week low, but it already bounced from 161 to 170 pre-market (gap 1.3x implied move), so the put only works if 172.6 caps it and 169 breaks.
